execution_record.verifier_only_correction: The first verification attempt exposed a verifier precision mismatch. Its independent StandardScaler reconstruction was corrected to cast mean and scale to the input float32 dtype before in-place arithmetic, matching scikit-learn 1.8. The second verification execution passed. No experiment script, protocol, model, or result was changed.

limitations: The bootstrap file hash was verified, but the bootstrap draws and confidence intervals were not independently replayed.

Independent tuning-threshold re-derivation covers the 36 baseline thresholds only. Gate threshold values were linked exactly to the saved model settings and predictions; gate threshold optimization was not independently rederived.
Independent NumPy gate reconstruction allows float32 NumPy/PyTorch numerical differences: alpha tolerance 5e-6 and source tuning AUROC tolerance 1e-4. Observed maximum errors are reported above.

This verifies saved artifacts, isolation, arithmetic and selected-setting consistency. It does not reproduce model training or establish statistical significance, blind-test validity, or generalization beyond the previously inspected development sources.
